Special Week achieved a brilliant result 
in the Japanese Derby, but her battle has 
only just begun.

Surrounded by many formidable rivals, 
including El Condor Pasa and Grass Wonder—

With an unreadable expression, Seiun Sky 
gave notice of their upcoming showdowns at 
the Kikuka Sho and the Tenno Sho (Spring).
